Vaisakh Sriram is a Software Developer & Graphic Designer based in Palakkad, Kerala, with a passion for turning ideas into bold, functional, and visually striking digital experiences. Alongside his full-time work, he freelances across software development, web design, UI/UX, and graphic design — blending technology and creativity to build products that don’t just work, but make an impression.

From developing high-performance software and crafting modern websites to designing intuitive interfaces and distinctive visual identities, he works across the entire digital spectrum. His work combines clean engineering, thoughtful design, and a strong eye for detail to create experiences that feel as good as they look.

He has designed and developed digital products and creative solutions for clients and organizations including Arshia Singh, River Promenade, and others.
